name: Location pin
what: A map pin drops and bounces, rings pulse out from its point the whole time, a place card pops up above it; optionally a map whose streets draw themselves in first.

learned_from.what: the red pin with a pulsing ripple, the place card popping above it
the pale blue map with a route drawn on it

motion: streets draw 20 f staggered; the pin drops 12 f (accelerating) and squashes (elastic 10 f); the card back.out 14 f; rings every 20 f, 36 f each
